additional_primary.scope: CRV manufacturer proportions/photographs; not exact APC/RCT30 variant proof

rct30_secondary.facts: Named RCT30 overall height 3.63 m; overall length 8.12 m, hull-vs-gun semantics unresolved; photo shows Puma turret, not CRV Lance turret

silhouette_requirements: Four axles/eight wheels; tall modular hull; angular driver cab and separated rear mission module. APC remote HMG; RCT30 has substantial unmanned 30 mm turret.
reference_limits: Wikipedia comparison table gives 7.93/2.99/2.38 m hull. Manufacturer CRV PDF is a turret reference, not proof that CRV equals RCT30.
frame_evidence: Envelope derived from cited family references where present. Mount/eye frames are approximate delegated authoring choices, NOT factory measurements; coordinator adopts matching physical rows before dispatch. Worker must never change frames unilaterally.

frame_correction.reason: ARTEC DB_APC.pdf explicitly defines 2.38 m hull roof. GTK_Boxer_side photo shows raised RCWS; chosen bore 0.45 m above published roof (2.83 m), yaw 2.51 m with existing 0.32 m muzzle offset. Optic eye 2.73 m is chosen near bore, not a factory measurement.
frame_correction.mount_measurement: Approximate photo-relative authoring; not measured mechanical specification

frame_correction.reason: Original 2.38 m was APC hull-roof height and omitted the RCT30 turret from the gun-role body envelope. Named Army Recognition RCT30 specification lists 3.63 m overall height. Adopt 3.63 m body including turret/optic, retain 7.93 m hull-only length (article 8.12 m length semantics unresolved). Source photos place turret ring near hull roof and bore above it; chosen yaw Z 2.38 m, bore Z 3.00 m (muzzle local Z 0.62), optic eye 3.40 m. Mount coordinates remain photo-relative authoring choices.
frame_correction.mount_measurement: Approximate photo-relative authoring; not measured mechanical specification
frame_correction.height_semantics: Chosen gameplay envelope excludes movable gun branch; includes main turret and rigid turret-fixed MUSS/optic tower. Named 3.63 m overall source does not explicitly say antenna-excluded; photo-fixed-tower anchoring is approximate, accepted by coordinator. No artificial roof filler; model must reproduce actual fixed tower.
